'''Fudbalski klub Drina Zvornik''' ([[Serbian Cyrillic]]: Фудбалски клуб Дрина Зворник) is a professional [[association football]] club from the city of [[Zvornik]] that is situated [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]].

The club competes in the [[First League of the Republika Srpska]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nezavisne.com/sport/fudbal/Poznati-svi-ucesnici-Prve-lige-RS-u-fudbalu/608363|title=Poznati svi učesnici Prve lige RS u fudbalu|date=3 July 2020|access-date=3 July 2020|language=bs|author=Vladimir Grbić|publisher=nezavisne.com}}</ref> and plays its home matches on the Gradski Stadion (''City Stadium'') in Zvornik, which has a capacity of 3,000 seats."}}
